 HoopsHype Nov. 10, 2026, 7:09 p.m. ET Daniel Donabedian: Nick Nurse on how Jaylen Brown is treating his first game against the Celtics : “Well, I had to talk to him a little bit this morning, see how he was doing. I think he's approaching it as another game, (a) big, big game. He’s excited for the opportunity, but he wasn't expressing it in a personal way. He said this is a really good test for our team, and I agree with him.”
